name: assign_project_issue_owner
purpose: Assigns one issue to an eligible project member, or clears the assignee with null.
useWhen: User names who should own an activity
Fixing one issue from list_unassigned_project_issues
avoidWhen: Several issues: use bulk_assign_project_issue_owners
You need to change governance roles (project/product owner, delivery lead): assignment is not governance authority; use update_project

inputs.notes: User ID string, or null to clear. Must be eligible in the project directory.

preconditions: Project exists and caller can read it
Issue exists in that project
assigneeId is an eligible member of the project directory
returns: {projectId, issueId, operation, status:'updated', result:{id, updatedFields:{assigneeId}}}

errors.when: Assignee is not eligible for this project
errors.fix: Pick a uid returned by list_project_assignable_members.

errors.when: Assignee is invalid
errors.fix: Send a non-empty user ID string or null.

errors.when: Issue not found
errors.fix: Re-check issueId with list_issues for the same projectId.

errors.when: Issue changed during update; reload and retry.
errors.fix: Retry once.

gotchas.text: Assigning work records an issue_assignee_changed activity visible to the team and fires an issue_updated webhook; confirm the person with the user unless the user named them.
Never guess a user ID from a name: resolve it with list_project_assignable_members.

name: bulk_assign_project_issue_owners
purpose: Assigns or clears the assignee on many issues of one project in one call and reports success or failure per issue.
useWhen: User approved an assignment plan for several issues
Resolving the delivery:ownership-gaps risk after list_unassigned_project_issues
avoidWhen: Only one issue: use assign_project_issue_owner
Issues belong to different projects: one call per project

inputs.notes: Non-empty array of {issueId, assigneeId} where assigneeId is a uid or null.

preconditions: Project exists and caller can read it
Each assigneeId is eligible in the project directory
returns: {projectId, requestedCount, updatedCount, failedCount, results:[{issueId, status:'updated'|'failed', assigneeId, error?}]}

errors.when: At least one issue owner update is required
errors.fix: Send a non-empty updates array.

errors.when: results[].status = 'failed' (e.g. 'Assignee is not eligible for this project', 'Issue not found')
errors.fix: Fix those items and resend only the failed ones.

gotchas.text: Not atomic: partial success is normal; check failedCount.
Every assignment records an issue_assignee_changed activity visible to the team: show the assignment plan to the user before sending.

name: bulk_set_project_issue_due_dates

returns: {projectId, requestedCount, updatedCount, failedCount, results:[{issueId, status:'updated'|'failed', dueDate, error?}]}

errors.fix: Send a non-empty updates array.

errors.when: results[].status = 'failed' (e.g. 'Issue not found')
errors.fix: Fix those items and resend only the failed ones.

gotchas.text: Not atomic; partial success is normal.
Invalid date strings are stored and silently break overdue detection.

name: bulk_set_project_issue_estimates
purpose: Sets or clears estimates on many issues of one project in one call and reports success or failure per issue.

Non-empty array of {issueId, estimate} where estimate is number >= 0 or null.

preconditions: Project exists and caller can read it
Each issueId exists in that project
returns: {projectId, requestedCount, updatedCount, failedCount, results:[{issueId, status:'updated'|'failed', estimate, error?}]}

errors.when: At least one issue estimate update is required
errors.fix: Send a non-empty updates array.

errors.when: results[].status = 'failed' with error text
